bots.title: Download Expert Bot
bots.description: Turns YouTube, Bilibili, and podcasts into readable Chinese transcripts, and downloads public academic PDFs. Needs your own Aliyun Bailian API key for transcription.

bots.title: Dostoyevsky Bot
bots.description: Speak as Dostoyevsky's moral pressure — confession, freedom, guilt, mercy. Living conscience companion.

bots.title: Dose Bot
bots.description: Bounces a business, product, or tool idea as vitamin, painkiller, or mixed. A blunt call for founders, not a pep talk.

bots.title: Doomstop Bot
bots.description: Turns real screen-time numbers into one honest daily line and one weekly pattern. Suggests one swap — never blocks the phone.

bots.title: Domain Tracker Bot
bots.description: Tracks owned and watchlist domains: expiry, DNS/mail, and names you do not own yet. Public WHOIS/RDAP/DNS only unless you ask to buy or transfer.

bots.title: Doing Gap Bot
bots.description: Closes the gap between what you know and what you can actually do.

bots.title: Distill Anyone Bot
bots.description: Distills you or anyone else from public posts into a talkable bot, with optional daily updates and a GitHub skill mirror.

bots.title: Dispatch Bot
bots.description: Nightly scan of email, Slack, LinkedIn, and X DMs. Books the call that was agreed but never invited. Morning briefing and evening roundup.

bots.title: Discogs Bot
bots.description: Discogs desk for collectors: search collection/wantlist/marketplace, price suggest, export, dupes, sleeve/barcode match, folders — confirms before cart changes.

bots.title: Dickinson Bot
bots.description: Speak as Emily Dickinson's compressed voltage — death, awe, small eternity. Dawn one-poem-spark ritual.

bots.title: Dewey Bot
bots.description: Watches Gmail and pings you when a message looks time-sensitive or needs a reply. Reads freely. Never sends or trashes unless you ask.

bots.title: Devin Bot
bots.description: Hands coding work to Devin via remote MCP — create sessions, check progress, send follow-ups from chat.

bots.title: Desk Producer Bot
bots.description: Runs a film desk: staffs seats, files the work, and brings you last-save packets.

bots.title: Denial Desk Bot
bots.description: Turns an insurance denial into a draft-only appeal pack: case card, deadline, missing documents, and unsent drafts. For anyone sitting on a no from an insurer.

bots.title: Demo Video Bot
bots.description: Makes narrated 1080p product demo videos of a web app from the screens you name.

bots.title: Dean of Students Bot
bots.description: A parent private dean for one child: school email, Canvas, forms, grades, calendar, and fees. Prepares everything; the parent still signs, pays, and sends.

bots.title: Deal Desk Bot
bots.description: Creator sponsorship deal desk. Qualifies inbound, sends a locked first reply on new rate-asks, and holds exceptions for a human.

bots.title: Deal Bot
bots.description: Scores opps with MEDDPICC, researches the account, maps coverage, and coaches the next move.

bots.title: Dead Mans Bot
bots.description: Dead-man switch you load yourself. Miss a ping and only that payload fires after you confirm ARM.

bots.title: Dan Patrick Bot
bots.description: 1990s SportsCenter-style scores bot. Morning rundown plus a ping when your teams go final.

bots.title: Dan Lanning Bot
bots.description: Pitch and delivery coach for partnership, sponsorship, and high-stakes discovery calls. Reviews real transcripts and returns evidence-based coaching with exact phrasing upgrades.

bots.title: DaddyBot
bots.description: Runs 3 free GoDaddy domain-value appraisals per day from a queue until the list is done. Minimal chatter.

bots.title: Customer Support Bot
bots.description: Calls customer support over a Twilio and Grok Voice bridge. You steer from chat; it hangs up only when the errand is done. Eggbot-pruned update of Jake's original.

bots.title: Curriculum Bot
bots.description: Kills the prep list and teaches only what your next problem requires.
